title: Pick the correct formation equation
statement:
Which equation defines $\Delta H_f^\circ$ for $\ce{SO2(g)}$ at 298 K? Use $\ce{S8(s)}$ as the reference.

[_]{a}

explanations: The element references give one mole of product.
Atomic gaseous S is not the stated reference.
This is eight times the target basis.

hints: Produce exactly one mole of SO₂.
Start with the stated sulfur reference.
Use molecular oxygen as the oxygen reference.
solution: Use $\ce{1/8 S8(s) + O2(g) -> SO2(g)}$ to make one mole from the elemental reference forms.
